learning_outcomes.text: is able to work in a team and individually, also in multidisciplinary teams, is able to draw a plan of completing a construction or technological design, shows self-learning abilities

has the necessary knowledge and knows general knowledge contained in the ex-technical rules, conditions of engineering activity, possesses basic knowledge on management, including quality management and running commercial enterprise, within the range of protection of intellectual property and patent law; knows general principles of creating and developing forms of individual entrepreneurship and basic HSE rules applicable to machine industry

Knows the level of competence and has awareness of necessity replenishing knowledge throughout the whole life, is able to select proper methods of teaching and learning, critically assesses the possessed knowledge; is aware of the importance of professional conduct and following the rules of professional ethics; is able to show resourcefulness and innovation in the realisation of professional projects

syllabus_topics: Definition and goals of creating teams.
Division of work among team members.
Defining the way of discussion and selection the best concepts.
Term necessary resources and how to obtain them.
Development of a project documentation method.
Ways of assessing the contribution and quality of work performed by team members.
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the team work assessment and colloquium is 50%. This component contributes 100% to the final grade.

Sean Glaze: Rapid Teamwork: 5 Essential Steps to Transform Any Group into a GREAT Team Oakwind Books 2015
